newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka air force plane crashlands, one dead.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka air force plane crashlands, one dead.

text.p: A Sri Lankan air force plane crashlanded on Saturday near the northern town of Anuradhapura, some 200 km (130 miles) north of the capital Colombo, killing one person and injuring another, the state radio said.
It said the aircraft was on a training mission when it crashlanded.
The radio gave no further details.

Sri Lanka's tiny airforce has already lost six aircraft this year in operations against the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam rebels, who are fighting for a separate homeland for minority Tamils in Sri Lanka's north and east.
